title: Does Not Work Well
text: Does Not Work Well. This broom does not work very well inside the house. It just seems to miss most of the smaller bits of dirt and dust. Yes, for bigger things, like cereal or something, you can easily sweep that up. But for the smaller day to day sweeping needs, it just falls very short. It is also awkward to use. The angle isn't adjustable and it isn't right for my height. The bristles are too small for an outdoor broom.
